title: Expedition 33 Weapons Locations - All Weapons Guide
description: Complete weapons location guide for Expedition 33 with every weapon for Gustave, Lune, Maelle, Sciel, Verso, and Monoco plus upgrade materials.

sections.title: Weapon System Overview
sections.content:
Every character in Expedition 33 has access to a unique pool of weapons that determine their base damage, elemental affinity, and passive bonuses. Weapons are found throughout the world via enemy drops, boss rewards, shops, and hidden Paint Cages.

Weapon Mechanics

  • Power Level: Determines base damage scaling. Higher-level weapons deal more damage.
  • Element: Most weapons have an elemental type that boosts matching skills
  • Passive Milestones: At certain upgrade levels (Level 4, 10, 20), weapons unlock unique passive abilities
  • Stat Scaling: Weapons scale with specific attributes (D through S rank)

Weapon Upgrade System

Weapons are upgraded at camp using Chroma (currency) and specific materials. Each upgrade increases the Power stat and unlocks passive bonuses at milestone levels. Fully upgrading a weapon significantly outperforms a higher-base-power weapon at Level 1.

Shared Weapons

Gustave and Verso share the same weapon pool (swords), so finding one weapon gives both characters access. Other characters have unique weapon types: Lune uses staves/wands, Maelle uses rapiers, Sciel uses cards/pendulums, and Monoco uses gauntlets.

Medalum is essential early game — it starts Maelle in Virtuose Stance. Later, choose between Jarum (Burn focus) or Lithum (Mark focus). Both grant Virtuose on counterattack at higher upgrade levels.

sections.title: Verso Weapons & Locations
sections.content:
Verso shares the sword weapon pool with Gustave but uses them differently through his Perfection Rank system. Certain weapons enable unique Verso-specific builds.

Shared Pool with Gustave

All swords listed in the Gustave section are also equippable by Verso. However, some weapons are particularly strong on Verso due to their passive interactions with Perfection Rank:

WeaponBest For Verso?Why
DualisoExcellentEffectively grants double turns — first builds Rank, second deals full S-Rank damage
GaulteramGoodDifferent element from Verso's innate Light/Physical, provides elemental coverage
LanceramGoodSolid power scaling available early, good stepping stone
ConfusoSituationalUseful for specific boss matchups
ChevalamExcellentLate-game power option from Chromatic Gold Chevaliere

Verso-Exclusive Build: Sireso

The Sireso weapon (from Axon Sirene) converts Verso into a dedicated support character. Perfection Rank no longer boosts his personal damage — instead it provides a damage bonus to all allies. Build to S-Rank, then spam party buffs.

sections.title: Monoco Weapons & Locations
sections.content:
Monoco the Gestral uses unique gauntlet-type weapons. His weapon pool is smaller than other characters but includes powerful support options.

WeaponLocationHow to Obtain

BallaroLate-gameFound in endgame area

Ballaro: The Support Powerhouse

Ballaro is Monoco's defining weapon for support builds. Its Level 10 and Level 20 passives provide additional AP to all party members when Monoco uses Upgraded Skills. This transforms Monoco into an AP battery — enabling your DPS characters to use expensive skills like Hell, Sword Ballet, or Elemental Genesis every single turn.

Monoco's Unique Advantage

Because Monoco transforms into enemies via his Bestial Wheel, his weapon is less central to his damage output compared to other characters. Focus on support-oriented weapons that boost the party rather than personal DPS.

sections.title: Upgrade Materials
sections.content:
Weapon upgrades require Chroma (currency) and specific crafting materials that drop from enemies and bosses throughout the game.

Material Tiers

TierSourceUsed For
Basic (Shards)Common enemies, early areasLevels 1-5
Intermediate (Fragments)Mid-game enemies, Act 1-2 bossesLevels 6-12
Advanced (Cores)Act 2-3 enemies, optional bossesLevels 13-18
Rare (Essences)Chromatic bosses, Endless TowerLevels 19-25

Farming Tips

  • Don't over-invest in early weapons — you'll find better ones naturally through progression
  • Focus upgrade materials on one weapon per character until mid-game
  • Chromatic boss materials are limited — plan which weapons to max before spending
  • The Endless Tower provides the best endgame material farming

Upgrade Priority

  • First priority: Your main DPS character's weapon (Maelle's Medalum or Jarum)
  • Second priority: Lune's weapon (affects healing AND damage output)
  • Third priority: Verso or Sciel's endgame weapon
  • Last: Support weapons like Ballaro (passive bonuses unlock at milestones, not gradual scaling)
